witness_description: The graph with vertices {0,1,2,3} and edges {(0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3)} is a 4-cycle.
refutation_explanation: This graph is triangle-free. Every vertex has eccentricity 2, so its center is {0,1,2,3}, which has four vertices and therefore violates the claimed upper bound of two.
search_space: All 64 labeled simple undirected graphs on vertex set {0,1,2,3} (all subsets of the 6 possible edges) were swept in increasing edge-mask order; connectedness, triangle-freeness, eccentricities, and centers were checked exactly.
